answer: Pre-dermal condensate (pre-Dc) cells migrate towards the epidermis. As they do, genes involved in cell adhesion (ADAMST1), cell-cell contacts (CLDN11) and directed migration (CXCL12) are upregulated along the hair fibroblast pseudotime, indicating a process of collective migration.
